summary: Acadia Realty Trust filed a prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5)) for an at-the-market continuous equity offering program of up to $500 million of common shares, following Amendment No. 1 to its February 14, 2025 ATM sales agreement with nine sales agents and eight forward purchasers. Prior sales totaled roughly $300.9 million, leaving about $199.1 million available. Sales occur at prevailing NYSE prices, with agent commissions up to 2.0%; forward sale agreements may be used. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and forward-sale settlement overhang.
